```{r, eval=FALSE}
library(ExactBayesCP)

dat <- bayescp_simulate(n = 100, tau = 50, mu1 = 0, mu2 = 1, seed = 1)
prior <- bayescp_prior(m01 = 0, m02 = 1, kappa01 = 5, kappa02 = 5)
fit <- bayescp_fit(dat$y, prior = prior, draws = 2000, seed = 1)

summary(fit)
plot(fit, type = "posterior")
```

## Checkpoint recovery

The study runner writes one atomic RDS checkpoint per scenario. A repeated call
with the same scenario identifier, replication count, and draw count validates
and reloads the saved output instead of recomputing it.
